 PREVIEW: Blackhawks Continue Homestand Against Maple Leafs
 Chicago continues its four-game homestand against Toronto on Tuesday night for the first of two meetings between the Original Six clubs this season
 By 
 Blackhawks.com Staff 
 Blackhawks.com 
 November 16, 2026 
 Link copied 
 🕒 TIME: 6:30 p.m.
📺 NATIONAL TV BROADCAST: TNT, HBO Max
🎙 RADIO:  WGN-720-AM | Blackhawks App
 More information on how to watch Blackhawks games this season can be found at Blackhawks.com/HowtoWatch .
 QUICK HITS
 Chicago continues its four-game homestand against the Toronto Maple Leafs on Tuesday night at United Center. 
 Connor Bedard is riding a six-game home point streak, totaling seven points (2G, 5A) in that stretch. 
 Roman Kantserov leads NHL rookies in goals (9) and shares fourth in points (12). 
 The Blackhawks own a 5-0-2 record when scoring a power play goal.
 AGAINST THE MAPLE LEAFS
 Chicago continues its four-game homestand with a Tuesday-night tilt against the Toronto Maple Leafs at United Center. This is the first of two meetings between the teams this season, with the second contest coming in Toronto on Jan. 14, 2027. 
 The Blackhawks boast an 11-1-3 record in their last 15 matchups against the Maple Leafs at United Center and have taken points in 24 of their last 31 games overall against Toronto (20-7-4). 
 Chicago owns 272 wins all-time against the Maple Leafs, including 167 on home ice. 
 Patrick Kane has totaled 21 points (11G, 10A) in 10 career games against Toronto at United Center. 
 In his last outing against them in a Blackhawks sweater (Feb. 19, 2023), the 37-year-old forward collected four points (3G, 1A). 
 Finnish winger  Teuvo Teravainen has potted goals in back-to-back games against Toronto at United Center. He has 16 points (7G, 9A) in 24 career games against them. 
 Forward Andrew Mangiapane enters Tuesday’s contest with seven points (3G, 4A) over his last 10 matchups against the Maple Leafs. 
 Kevin Korchinski has recorded points (1G, 1A) in each of his two career games against Toronto, including his first career point on Oct. 16, 2023. 
 Frank Nazar comes into Tuesday’s matchup with points (2A) in back-to-back games against the Maple Leafs at United Center.
 Defenseman Wyatt Kaiser has recorded points (1G, 1A) in consecutive games against Toronto. 
 Ian Cole notched two assists in his last meeting against the Maple Leafs on Jan. 13, 2026. 
 Cole Smith has registered points (1G, 2A) in three of his last four games against Toronto, including a goal in his last matchup against them on Dec. 20, 2025. 
 Tyler Bertuzzi handed out a pair of assists in his last game against the Maple Leafs at United Center on Feb. 23, 2025. 
 Spencer Knight owns a 2-1-0 record and .914 save percentage over his last three appearances against Toronto, including a 31-save performance in his last meeting against them at United Center. 
 The Darien, Conn. native is 2-2-0 with a 3.06 goals-against average and .895 save percentage in four career appearances against them.
 PLAYERS TO WATCH
 PATRICK KANE | RW | #88 
 AUSTON MATTHEWS | C | #34 
 Tallied an assist on Saturday afternoon against the Winnipeg Jets.
 Ranks second on the team in assists (9) and third in points (10) so far this season.
 Sits 20th in NHL history in assists, handing out 901 helpers in his 1,386-game career.
 Needs just four goals to move into a tie for third in NHL history in goals scored among U.S.-born players.
 Leads the Maple Leafs in points (29), assists (17) and goals (12) so far this season. 
 Ranks top-10 in the league in goals (7th) and points (8th) in 2026-27.
 Enters Tuesday's game with three points (1G, 2A) over his last five outings.
 Has produced 809 points (440G, 369A) across 711 career NHL regular-season games.
 TURBO CHARGED
 Teuvo Teravainen registered two assists against the Jets on Saturday afternoon, lifting him to six helpers on the season ... The Finnish winger is just three assists (97) away from reaching the century mark in a Blackhawks sweater ... Teravainen has three points (3A) over his last three appearances at United Center ... Across his 843-game NHL career, he has produced 560 points (186G, 374A).
 FRANK THE TANK
 Frank Nazar lit the lamp against the Jets on Saturday at United Center, pushing him to eight goals on the season ... The Detroit, Mich. native has recorded goals (3G) in back-to-back games and has found the back of the net five times over his last five appearances ... Nazar enters Tuesday’s contest with four points (3G, 1A) over his last four games at United Center ... He ranks second on the team in goals (8) and shares third in points (10) so far this season.
 OH CAPTAIN, MY CAPTAIN
 Connor Bedard found the back of the net and handed out an assist against Winnipeg on Nov. 14 at United Center ... The North Vancouver native enters Tuesday’s matchup riding a three-game point streak, scoring two goals and handing out three assists in that stretch ... The 21-year-old forward is the youngest player in Blackhawks history to reach 80 career goals (21 years, 113 days old) ... Chicago’s captain has points in 12 of his 14 games played this season, pacing the team in points (17) and assists (11), while ranking third in goals (6).
